SELECT
    SourceSystem,
    SourceSchema,
    SourceTable,
    BronzeContainer,
    BronzeFolder,
    BronzeFileName,
    SilverContainer,
    SilverFolder,
    GoldTable,
    LoadType,
    PrimaryKeyColumn,
    WatermarkColumn,
    IsActive,
    LoadSequence
FROM dbo.ADF_Table_Metadata
WHERE IsActive = 1
ORDER BY LoadSequence;
